design.production_training_resubstitution: Fit each classifier to all constructed feature rows, then predict those same rows. Self-neighbors are included. Apparent fit only.
design.historical_split_training_resubstitution: Fit to historical 80% grouped partition, then predict those same training rows.
design.historical_split_development_test: Predict historical 20% grouped partition. GroupShuffleSplit, specimen_group, random_state=42. Reproduces prior report, but related-capture grouping is imperfect and configurations were tuned on this split.
design.sensitivity_specificity: Unweighted means of per-category one-vs-rest TP/(TP+FN) and TN/(TN+FP). Labels are union of actual and predicted categories within each partition. Undefined denominators use zero to reproduce the historical convention. Not clinical positive-versus-negative sensitivity/specificity.
design.kappa: Unweighted Cohen kappa, not ordinal weighted kappa.
design.scope: Cached-feature classification only. No image-detector, confidence-abstention or new distance-rejection filtering. No independent clinical validation.

verification: All 50 historical per-analyte metric values reproduced within 1e-12; confusion matrix totals reconciled.
